explanation: Heavy body (m=20, vx=60) pins light body (m=0.2) against thin 0.1-wide wall. At step 1 both move ~59.4 m/s with the pair overlapping (gap -0.001) and the light body 0.10 from the wall. The contact solver then ejects the trapped light body through the wall: at step 2 it is at x=10.82, past the wall span [10,10.1], while the heavy body stops at the wall. Likely cause: body-body impulse/positional correction fires the squeezed body at high velocity into/through the thin wall within one step, and wall collision handling fails to stop the far-side crossing.
